title: Chapter 2717: Level 6 Treatment
content:
Chapter 2717: Level 6 Treatment

"In any case, putting the name aside, Infinity isn’t something we’re capable of wielding directly." Yu Rou continued. "Are you saying that you can use such power?"

Yuan nodded.

"Are you willing to share your technique with us? If we could wield it, then we have a much greater chance of defeating the invaders."

"It’s not a technique. I acquired the ability to wield it after evolving my physique to a certain level."

"Don’t tell me... the Perfected Heavenly Refinement?" Yu Rou muttered with a concerned look on her face.

"No, I was able to use Eternal Essence—or Infinity—long before I achieved my current level. However, I wasn’t taught how to use it. I just naturally started using it."

"You’re telling me that you just started wielding Infinity one day randomly?"

"Pretty much."

After a moment of silence, Yuan asked, "Are you sure no one has ever been able to wield Infinity? What about Tian Yuchen? Or those who cleared the 40th floor and above in Endless Assault? I was only able to clear those floors because I could wield such power."

Since everyone in this world essentially possessed the same physique as him, Yuan wouldn’t have been surprised if Tian Yuchen and everyone else in this world had the capability to wield Eternal Essence as well. Otherwise, it made little sense that they had been able to defeat entities capable of wielding it.

’Unless our physiques are not actually the same...’ Yuan thought to himself as he suddenly realized this possibility.

Of course, there was also the possibility that his physique had evolved differently from the others, hence why nobody had ever been able to attain the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique.

"None of them could wield Infinity," Yu Rou said, shaking her head.

"So they managed to clear those floors using Limitless alone...? I can’t fathom how that’s possible," Yuan muttered, looking genuinely puzzled.

Although Limitless was powerful and derived from Eternal Essence, it couldn’t compare to the raw energy in the slightest. Yuan simply couldn’t imagine how they had managed to defeat Eternal-level opponents using Limitless alone.

Yu Rou then asked, "What made you think Tian Yuchen or the others could wield Infinity? Just because they cleared the 40th floor and above in Endless Assault? Although the difficulty certainly spikes after the 40th floor, it’s nowhere near the level where Infinity would be necessary. Otherwise, those floors would be impossible to clear."

"Huh?" Yuan stared at her, looking dumbfounded.

"Even though the opponents could use Infinity?"

Yu Rou raised her eyebrows in confusion before responding, "What are you talking about? That’s impossible, and I would know, as I created the place."

In that moment, Yuan realized the Endless Assault he had experienced was different from everyone else’s. Tian Yuchen and the others had faced entirely different opponents, and unlike his, those opponents did not wield Eternal Essence.

"You have got to be shitting me..." he cursed under his breath.

"Can you explain the situation?" Yu Rou suddenly asked.

Yuan nodded and explained that the opponents he encountered in Endless Assault could wield Eternal Essence. He even revealed that the48th floor had pitted him against an entity that closely resembled the Void Hunter.

Yu Rou’s mouth dropped slightly upon hearing Yuan’s experience, and she said, "I don’t want to call you a liar, but that’s literally impossible, as it’s not even programmed to have such capabilities."

"..."

The place fell silent as Yuan and Yu Rou stared at each other, unsure what to say next.

Eventually, Yuan said, "Although I can’t teach you how to wield Infinity, I can make everyone stronger than before."

"How?"

"By making everyone cultivate manually instead of using the system."

"Cultivating... manually?"

Yuan explained, "The cultivation system is extremely effective at gathering Limitless to increase one’s cultivation, but when it comes to replenishing exhausted Limitless, it’s terribly inefficient.

"If you compared the cultivation system to a water pipe that split into two paths—one for increasing cultivation and the other for recovery—it would send most of the water toward cultivation, even if the person were completely exhausted and desperately needed that energy for recovery instead."

"Unless you can somehow alter the cultivation system and adjust how efficiently it distributes energy, one must cultivate manually to compensate for this major weakness."

Yu Rou sighed and said, "As I said earlier, I didn’t create the system. I merely distributed it."

"In that case, everyone must learn to cultivate manually. I have already taught a few soldiers this method, and they’ve shown tremendous improvements in a short time."

"That’s easier said than done. Cultivating through the system is far more convenient, and most people have never even tried cultivating manually once. That said, we’ll make it happen." Yu Rou said, turning to look at Supreme General Tian.

"I will make sure everyone starts cultivating manually by the end of the day," he said.

"Hopefully, it’s not already too late..." Supreme General Tian sighed.

"Are you responsible for the barrier?" Yuan asked Yu Rou a moment later.

"The one holding back the invasion? No. I didn’t even know it existed until recently."

"Is that so? Then it’s either a natural phenomenon or something someone else created—most likely the Eternal who’s been helping you. And while I don’t know how long it’ll last, it should keep the invaders at bay for some time."

Yu Rou then said, "Even if the barrier collapses tomorrow, we must do everything we can with the time we’re given to prepare for the invasion."

"What about the other cities?" Supreme General Tian suddenly asked. "Should we share this knowledge with them?"

"We’re not in a position to be selfish. Since we’ll be working together to face this calamity, it only benefits us if they become stronger as well. Even if that decision comes back to bite us in the future, there won’t be a future to worry about if we fail to protect this world from the invaders," said Yu Rou.

She then turned to face Yuan and asked, "What about you? Is there anything I can do for you? Since we’ll rely mostly on your power, I’ll do everything within my capabilities to support you starting now."

Yuan pondered for a moment before responding, "Well, you can increase my Credential Rank."

Without a word, Yu Rou immediately brought up her system to fulfill Yuan’s request.

<You have received Gaia’s Endorsement>

<Your Credential Rank has increased several levels>

[Credential Rank: 9]

In the blink of an eye, Yuan’s Credential Rank jumped to the peak with Yu Rou’s help.

"With this, I’ll finally be able to get rid of all the curses afflicting me..." Yuan muttered, his voice trembling with a mixture of excitement and nervousness.

Since he could no longer increase his Eternal Essence without first completing his Eternal Constitution, the only other way Yuan could think of to grow stronger was to remove the unknown curses that had been binding him.

However, considering what had happened during his previous treatment, he couldn’t help but fear what might happen once he began removing even stronger curses.

It wasn’t the unbearable pain that worried him most, either. What truly concerned him was the possibility of losing consciousness and falling into another coma. If it lasted months again—or even years—he could easily end up sleeping through the entire invasion.

"Anything else?" Yu Rou asked a moment later.

"The only other thing you can really do for me is try to get in contact with the Eternal helping you. Other than that... I’ll handle the rest."

"Alright. If you need to speak with me after today, you can come back here as you please."

Yuan and Supreme General Tian left Gaia’s world shortly later.

Before leaving the room containing the teleportation device, Supreme General Tian had Yuan register his fingerprints and complete a retinal scan.

"Now you’ll be able to visit Gaia by yourself, as I’ll be too busy to be your guide."

"Thanks."

"Don’t even think of doing anything stupid. Gaia may not look like it, but she’s unfathomably strong."

"You still don’t trust me?"

"I trust you, but I can still be suspicious or wary of you."

"Good enough for me."

"What are you going to do now?" Supreme General Tian then asked.

"I’m going to remove the curses that are still on me."

Supreme General Tian immediately frowned and said, "You won’t go into a coma like last time... will you?"

Yuan shrugged.

"I don’t know."

"I swear, if you fall into a coma and the invasion begins, I’ll wake you up even if I have to waterboard you."

"That’s reassuring to hear. Even if you hadn’t said it, I would’ve asked you to do the same," Yuan remarked with a smile—and he genuinely meant it.

After they went their separate ways, Supreme General Tian went to introduce the new training method to the rest of the military, while Yuan returned to his living quarters to prepare for his level 6 treatment.

"I don’t care if it’s even more painful than last time... Just don’t put me into a coma..." Yuan prayed aloud before he began the treatment.

<Utilizing Level 6 Treatment>

<Warning! Warning! Warning!>

[Warning: Level 6 treatment may cause intense pain for the user due to the nature of the anomaly]

[Warning: Level 6 treatment may affect the user’s memories due to the nature of the anomaly]

This time, there were two warnings instead of just one.

"Huh? My memories...?" Yuan muttered in a daze, staring at the second warning with a puzzled expression.

The first warning was completely within his expectations, but the second left him speechless and deeply concerned.
